title: How Does Artificial Intelligence Shape Audit Firms?
eligible_reason: Staggered binary treatment (treat_ai = 1 after an audit office first hires an AI employee) with office and year FE, but every regression in the replication code includes six time-varying office-year controls ($controls = n_sic2 marketshare ln_n_clients hhi_deciles left_ratio ln_total_audit_fees) or, for client-level tables, a long vector of time-varying client controls. No specification without time-varying controls. The package ships no data (Revelio Labs, Burning Glass, Audit Analytics).
design_notes: Stata 17, reghdfe 5.7.3 ('Replicate Code.do'; data expected under Data/main_sample, skill_sample, iv_sample, gc_sample, icmw_sample, rest_sample, none shipped). Table 3: reghdfe {ln_n_accounting, ln_n_audit, ln_n_tax, ln_n_consult} treat_ai $controls [aweight = n_employee], abs(officeid year) cluster(msaid#year); log shows N = 4,417 office-years, 648 offices, 9 years (2011-2019). Table 4: junior/middle/senior auditor counts, same design. Table 5: job-posting level skill indicators with officeid and cleantitleid#year FE, clustered by job title. Table 6: IV (ai_talent_supply). Table 7: robustness (alternative treatment treat_ai_alt, subsamples, alternative clustering). Tables 8-9: client-level outcomes (going-concern errors, restatements) with officeid, fyear, gvkey or sic2 FE and client controls. Logs in Log/*.smcl contain full output.
estimators_reported: reghdfe TWFE static with time-varying controls and analysis weights (office + year FE, clustered by MSA x year)
n_adoption_cohorts: unknown (no data in package); offices adopt over 2011-2019

ineligible_specs.reason: time-varying office controls n_sic2 marketshare ln_n_clients hhi_deciles left_ratio ln_total_audit_fees
time-varying controls; job-posting level with title-by-year FE
time-varying controls; alternative treatment definition and subsamples
client-level time-varying controls; additional gvkey/sic2 FE

screener_notes: Package: ~/did_packages/mnsc/mnsc.2022.04040/Replicate Kit/ (README.md with variable dictionary, Code/Replicate Code.do, Log/*.smcl for each table and figure). The Data/ folder referenced by the code is absent; sources are Revelio Labs, Burning Glass, Audit Analytics, ACS. Published coefficients are recoverable from the logs. A no-controls version of Table 3 would qualify in design but is neither reported nor runnable without the data.
